test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The first Mughal Emperor to be buried outside India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Babur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Babur**, the founder of the **Mughal Empire** in the Indian subcontinent, was the first emperor of the dynasty to be buried outside the borders of modern-day **India**.
 
• After defeating **Ibrahim Lodi** in the **First Battle of Panipat** in **1526**, he established his rule in North India but died shortly after in **Agra** on **December 26, 1530**.
 
• Initially, his body was interred in the **Aram Bagh** (Garden of Rest) in **Agra**, situated on the banks of the **Yamuna River**.
 
• However, **Babur** had expressed a strong sentimental desire in his autobiography, the **Baburnama**, to be buried in his favorite city, **Kabul**, in **Afghanistan**.
 
• During the reign of either **Sher Shah Suri** or his son **Humayun** (around **1539–1544**), his remains were moved to the **Bagh-e Babur** (Gardens of Babur) in **Kabul**.
 
• His tomb is located in a **Charbagh** (four-fold garden) layout, which became a signature architectural style for future **Mughal** mausoleums.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Humayun**:

 
 
• The second **Mughal** emperor is buried in **Delhi**. His tomb is a **UNESCO World Heritage Site** and was the first major **Mughal** structure to use red sandstone on such a large scale.
 
 
 
• **Akbar**:
 
 
• The third emperor, **Akbar the Great**, is buried in a magnificent tomb at **Sikandra**, located on the outskirts of **Agra**.
 
 
 
• **Shah Jahan**:
 
 
• The fifth emperor is buried in the **Taj Mahal** in **Agra**, placed next to his beloved wife, **Mumtaz Mahal**.
 
 
 
• **Other Emperors Buried Outside India**:
 
 
• **Jahangir** was buried in **Shahdara Bagh** in **Lahore**, **Pakistan**.
 
• **Bahadur Shah Zafar**, the last **Mughal** emperor, was exiled by the British and buried in **Yangon**, **Myanmar**.
